## Summary
- P2 ExtensionHost runtime: host/worker wiring hardening for product ExtensionHost path.
- Requires real extension load/execute evidence, not compile-only success.
- Kept separate from IDE product-path and AgentSession PRs until acceptance gates pass.

## Scope (this PR only)
- Validate host/worker startup, IPC, shutdown, and crash recovery.
- Verify actual extension loading and execution on a SHA-specific binary.
- Preserve frozen daily-driver baseline `A4F083DFΓÇª` (no regression).

## Explicit non-claims
- `PROMOTE=0`
- `CERTIFIED=0`
- Opening this PR does **not** authorize merge.
- Prior Finish-25 authority remains **19/25** until new SHA-specific evidence changes it.
- Do not inherit PASS results from another executable or from PR #77 / AgentSession PR.
- Compile/link success alone is **not** ExtensionHost PASS.
- 330 MB tip dumps and temporary generated files must stay out of Git.

## Test plan
- [ ] Clean build + link of Win32IDE + ExtensionHost worker from this branch tip
- [ ] Host starts worker; IPC handshake succeeds
- [ ] Load and execute a real extension (not stub-only)
- [ ] Exercise shutdown and crash-recovery paths fail-closed
- [ ] Confirm no regression vs frozen baseline `A4F083DFΓÇª`
- [ ] Record SHA-specific evidence for this executable only
- [ ] Leave `PROMOTE=0` / `CERTIFIED=0` until independently validated

## Integration order
1. IDE Product Path (PR #77) ΓÇö separate gates
2. AgentSession GUI (prior PR) ΓÇö separate gates
3. This PR (ExtensionHost Runtime)
4. Only after all three merge + pass: unified full-feature candidate ΓåÆ Finish-25 ΓåÆ release audit
title: P2: ExtensionHost runtime ΓÇö host/worker, IPC, shutdown, crash recovery
